zh: Dragon 浏览器「⋯」菜单的收藏夹、历史记录、下载内容改为二级菜单：鼠标移上去即展开，按屏幕空间自动在左侧或右侧弹出（桌面版用系统原生子菜单，独立窗口保留「管理…」入口；网页侧栏同样悬停展开，支持方向键）。
en: Bookmarks, History and Downloads in the Dragon browser ⋯ menu are now submenus that open on hover and flip left or right to fit the screen (native submenus on desktop, with a Manage… entry in the standalone window; hover flyouts with arrow-key support in the web sidebar).
